project.name: SkillSwapAI
project.summary: A Next.js and NestJS skill-exchange platform with social requests, realtime chat, scheduling, queued AI matching, PostgreSQL, Redis, and object storage.

instructionFiles: AGENTS.md and applicable nested instruction files
CLAUDE.md and applicable nested instruction files
docs/qa/README.md for QA integration and environment details
commands: pnpm qa:validate — QA adapter, manifest, hook, MCP, and platform-parity validation
pnpm --dir frontend exec vitest run <file> — focused frontend
facts: Frontend is Next.js 16/React 19 with TanStack Query; backend is NestJS 11 under /api except health endpoints.
Prisma/PostgreSQL is authoritative; Redis may fall back in development.
Global DTO validation whitelists fields and rejects undeclared fields.
Authentication uses httpOnly access_token and refresh_token cookies.
AI matches and suggestions are queued; Socket.IO drives realtime client invalidation.
risks: Authentication, refresh/logout, ownership, roles, and cross-user isolation
Request/friend/session state transitions, duplicate actions, and timezone overlap
Queued AI work, socket delivery, retry/idempotency, reconnect, and eventual consistency
DTO/client contract drift, stale query cache, accessibility, and responsive layout
boundaries: OpenAI/AI provider, Redis/BullMQ, S3, email, database, Socket.IO, and remote environments
In-memory fallback is not evidence for multi-instance Redis, queue, or socket behavior
journeys: Discover, request, accept/reject, and friend visibility
Queued match generation through ready/failure notification and detail
